title: Fantastic excursion from Barcelona!
text: My partner and I decided to hire this tour and it was a great decision. The two guides were incredibly friendly, picked us up at the hotel and attended us with great kindness. They know the region and the wine tradition very well, the explanations were very detailed and in-depth which creates a great atmosphere throughout the excursion. The landscape is incredible and the wineries maintain traditional methods to produce superlative wines. Upon returning to Barcelona we were dropped off at the hotel and given a small gift. 100% recommended!
author: 153guillemp

title: Amazing day in Priorat
text: It was an incredible day, they picked us up at our hotel, they took us to taste wines from two beautiful wineries in the priorat, and in the second we had a pairing and they fed us with the wines from the winery. We are going to recommend this activity to our friends who come to Barcelona
